messages:
kai: heads-up — warm-pool GPU nodes in us-east-1 are failing KMS decrypt during provisioning after tonight's egress lockdown deploy. nodes stuck in Provisioning -> DecryptError :sob:
ops-bot: Incident created INC-8342 — priority: high. pinging oncall.
anna: logs?
kai: paste from node-init:
```
2026-03-20T01:02:33Z node-init: Attempting KMS decrypt https://kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com -> timeout
Error: Get https://kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com: dial tcp 52.0.0.1:443: i/o timeout
```
sam: did the lockdown terraform deny outbound 443 except to S3 endpoints?
jack: yes — we rolled a deny-all egress and only added gateway endpoints for S3 and internal control plane. we removed the interface endpoints to simplify during the change.
anna: fwiw kms requires an Interface endpoint (ENIs) or internet egress; gateway endpoints don't cover KMS. removing the interface endpoints would break decrypts.
kai: can we do a quick revert or soft-open for the warm-pool subnets? we have ~150 nodes stuck.
sam: short-term options: (1) add SG egress rule allowing 443 to KMS IP ranges (fragile), (2) provision an interface endpoint -> needs ENI quota + terraform apply, (3) route through an HTTPS proxy.
jack: NAT GW would also work but costy — per-AZ NATs plus data charges.
anna: prefer interface endpoint restore. i'll open a terraform PR to re-add `aws_vpc_endpoint` (interface) for `kms` in the warm-pool subnets and pin subnet IDs. will also add ENI quota check to the module.
sam: i'll do a temporary SG change to get nodes unstuck while the PR goes through. quick command i used in staging (replace group id):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0abc1234 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 52.0.0.0/16
```
note: KMS IPs are not stable long-term.
jack: cost note: if we route via NAT for the warm pool during heavy boot (150 nodes * 50MB avg) could be ~$30/day just on NAT charges; interface endpoints are cheaper and more stable.
kai: also flagging compliance: private customer deployments will show failed decrypts in audit logs — we should notify security/compliance if this persists.
anna: i'll add @security and @legal to the incident ticket and attach the failed-decrypt audit sample. :loudspeaker:
jack: postmortem TODO: add deploy pipeline check that validates KMS egress for warm pools and a smoke canary that boots 3 nodes after egress changes.
kai: agreed. i'll also start rebalancing low-priority jobs to us-west-2 while we fix this to reduce customer impact.
sam: temporary SG rule applied at 01:10 UTC against warm-pool sg. nodes are progressing past decrypt now. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident INC-8342 updated -> resolved by mitigation (temporary sg rule) at 01:35 UTC.
kai: thanks everyone — anna please link PR and schedule the interface endpoint rollout canary. closing loop, will add metrics to infra-runway doc.
